commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks do not show whether they are completed, and users
cannot update their completion status.

Let's,
* add mark and unmark commands
* display completion status in the task list
* handle invalid task numbers without exiting
* document the Task class and its methods

commitResults.messageTitle: Add test cases for AI to check against
Move task status formatting into Task.toString
Add support for tracking three types of tasks.
commitResults.messageBody:
Add support for to-dos, deadlines, and events.

Parse task descriptions and date/time information from user input.
Use inheritance so each task type extends the common Task class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve quality of AI test cases
Improve quality of AI test cases

commitResults.messageBody:
Add custom exception handling for malformed commands, invalid task
indexes, empty descriptions, and incomplete deadlines and events.
Provide specific error messages without changing the task list state.

Add support for deleting tasks by index and preserve task-list state
when deletion input is invalid. Extend the UI test plan with positive
and negative Level-6 deletion cases.

Replace hardcoded task type markers with the TaskType enum and update
task subclasses to use enum-based formatting. Add UI tests covering
task markers, state changes, and case-insensitive commands.

Represent chatbot commands with CommandType and dispatch them through
an enum-based switch. Validate invalid command arguments and add UI
tests for command dispatch.

Fix command switch indentation, document the Penguin constructor, and
remove the redundant ToDo toString override.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task persistence and data validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Save and reload tasks across sessions, validate malformed records,
and skip invalid saved tasks without stopping the loading process.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add date filtering and future date validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Add the `on` command to display deadlines and events occurring on a
specified date. Replace string-based date/time values with
LocalDateTime, validate input strictly, reject values before today,
and provide clear errors for invalid or out-of-range values.

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow ongoing events to start before today
commitResults.messageBody:
Permit events to have a start date before the current date while
requiring their end date to be today or later. Apply the same validation
when loading saved events and preserve event start/end ordering checks.

Extract user interaction into Ui, command parsing into Parser, and
individual actions into Command subclasses. Remove the unused
CommandType enum and move task-list display logic into Ui while
preserving existing validations and behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize Penguin classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Group commands, tasks, parsing, storage, UI, utilities, enums, and
exceptions into suitable packages while preserving existing behavior,
validations, persistence, and UI output.

Update user-facing messages, documentation, test descriptions, and
skill metadata to use `Penguin` instead of qualified package names while
retaining `penguin.Penguin` for the Java entry point.

Merge the Gradle support branch and configure the application to use
penguin.Penguin as the Gradle entry point. Verify that Gradle can
compile and build the project successfully.

Add JUnit tests for core parsing, task management, command execution,
date/time handling, persistence, UI output, and end-to-end workflows.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parser tests: Use explicit JUnit imports

commitResults.messageBody:
Mandate the SE-EDU Java coding standard for project source and test code.

Provide reusable checks for naming, layout, imports, visibility, Javadocs,
and JUnit test conventions.

Provide project-specific rules for commit subjects, commit bodies, and branch names.

Use the SE-EDU conventions to keep future Git history consistent and informative.

Require the project-specific Java and Git standards for future work.

Keep Java implementation consistent with SE-EDU conventions and require
SE-EDU-compliant commit messages and branch names.

Support searching tasks by keyword or phrase while preserving the existing date-search command.

Normalize whitespace in find input and provide matching and no-match output
so users can locate tasks without changing the task list.

Cover valid keyword searches, multi-word input, repeated whitespace,
missing keywords, no matches, and case-sensitive behavior.

Document the corresponding positive, negative, and edge-case workflows in
the UI test plan.

The project needs automated checks for Java coding-standard
violations.

Add the Checkstyle Gradle plugin and configuration aligned with the
SE-EDU Java coding standard so formatting and naming issues can be
identified consistently.

Constructor parameters shadow fields in several command, task, storage,
and enum classes.

Rename the parameters and update their Javadocs to improve readability
and remove Checkstyle hidden-field warnings.

Improve the GUI with responsive layout, futuristic styling,
animated chat messages, and wrapped dialog content.

Move JavaFX GUI classes into the penguin.gui package and update
imports and FXML controller references.
